what_happened.line: The Historical Commission held a visioning session on the history of the Town Center, ahead of a village district zoning bylaw.
A commission member presented a slide history of the Town Center's buildings and surrounding roads, tied to the planning board's bylaw work and the building reuse committee.
The presenter said reusing town buildings could free up money the town spends each year to operate them and return them to the tax rolls.
The planning board will hold a further public outreach meeting on July 30th on the future of the Town Center.
No votes were taken other than adjournment, and no public comment was captured.

why_it_matters: The village district bylaw would change how land and buildings in the Town Center can be used, and it would likely go to Town Meeting for a vote. The cost of running town-owned buildings falls on the town budget, mostly taxes.
